Container.Name: FaceDetection
Container.Overview: Household Face Detection, UniFi Protect Auto-Training API, and Management Dashboard with SQLite persistence.

Config.Name: WebUI & API Port
Config.Description: Container Web Interface and API Port

Config.Name: Appdata Config Directory
Config.Description: Path to persistent configuration, SQLite database (faces.db), learned face models, and thumbnails.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Unraid user ID (default nobody: 99)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Unraid group ID (default users: 100)

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File permissions mask

Config.Name: Face Model
Config.Description: Model profile: 'buffalo_l' (high accuracy) or 'buffalo_s' (ultra-fast for low-latency CPU)

Config.Name: Face Detector Engine
Config.Description: Face detection model: 'yolov8_face' (dual-stage with ArcFace, filters outdoor false-positives) or 'scrfd' (InsightFace default)

Config.Name: Inference Threads
Config.Description: OpenMP/ONNX thread limit. Prevents thread contention/thrashing on high core count CPUs (4-8 recommended).

Config.Name: Detection Resolution
Config.Description: Detection square size: 320 (ultra-fast ~20-50ms), 480 (balanced), 640 (maximum range)

Config.Name: Max Image Dimension
Config.Description: Downscale 4K/2K frames to max dimension in pixels before inference to avoid memory bloat

Config.Name: Similarity Threshold
Config.Description: Cosine similarity match threshold (0.40 - 0.55 recommended)

Config.Name: Detection Sensitivity
Config.Description: Minimum face detection confidence threshold

Config.Name: Admin Username
Config.Description: Initial administrator username for Web UI login

Config.Name: Webhook Secret Token
Config.Description: Optional token to secure UniFi Protect PUT webhook via X-Webhook-Secret header

Config.Name: RTSP Stream URL
Config.Description: Optional RTSP stream URL to auto-connect on startup

Config.Name: RTSP Auto-Start
Config.Description: Auto-start RTSP stream processing on container boot (true/false)

Config.Name: RTSP Camera Name
Config.Description: Camera identifier for real-time detections

Config.Name: RTSP Sampling Rate (FPS)
Config.Description: Inference sampling frequency in frames per second (2.0 - 5.0 recommended)

Config.Name: RTSP Alert Cooldown (s)
Config.Description: Cooldown between repeat alerts per person in seconds

Config.Name: Notification Threshold
Config.Description: Minimum similarity score required before dispatching an outgoing webhook or MQTT alert (0.50 - 0.70 recommended)

Config.Name: Alert on Unknown Faces
Config.Description: Dispatch notifications for unrecognized visitor faces (true/false)

Config.Name: Unknown Face Min Confidence
Config.Description: Minimum face detection confidence required before alerting on unknown faces (filters false positives)

Config.Name: RTSP Outgoing Webhook URL
Config.Description: Webhook URL to POST detection events to (e.g. Home Assistant webhook)

Config.Name: Webhook Only for Known Faces
Config.Description: Restrict outgoing webhooks strictly to recognized household members and suppress for unknown faces (true/false)

Config.Name: MQTT Broker Enabled
Config.Description: Publish real-time detection events to an MQTT broker (true/false)

Config.Name: MQTT Broker Host
Config.Description: MQTT broker IP address or hostname

Config.Name: MQTT Broker Port
Config.Description: MQTT broker port

Config.Name: MQTT Topic
Config.Description: MQTT publication topic

Config.Name: MQTT Only for Known Faces
Config.Description: Publish MQTT events strictly for recognized household members and suppress for unknown faces (true/false)
